Which areas have the highest fair market rent for a two-bedroom apartment?
SELECT areaname, max(try_cast(fmr2 AS double)) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals filed Medicare cost reports for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2024'
Which car makes draw the most owner complaints to federal safety regulators?
SELECT maketxt, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards were funded with COVID-19 relief money?
SELECT sum(try_cast(award_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency'
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many voting-age citizens live in the Bronx?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE geoname = 'Bronx County, New York' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Which companies supply the most dry cask systems for storing spent nuclear fuel?
Dataset Waste Spent Fuel Storage Dry Cask Query 15
SELECT vendor, count(*) AS installations FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_waste_spent_fuel_storage_dry_cask_query_15 WHERE vendor <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pension plans reported a funding deficiency on Schedule R?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE try_cast(pen_funding_deficiency_amt AS double) > 0
At what hours of the day did the most fatal crashes happen in 2022?
SELECT hourname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Does the library hold more CRS reports or GAO reports?
SELECT source, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which Pennsylvania counties gave the most votes to the Republican presidential candidate in 2020?

SELECT county_name, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'PENNSYLVANIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'REPUBLICAN' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did sulfur dioxide from U.S. power plants change from 1995 to 2023?
SELECT year(date) AS year, sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) IN (1995, 2023) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which industries received the most Homeland Security contract money in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured banks are still active today?
SELECT count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE cast(active AS varchar) = '1'
Which states have the largest legislatures?
SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE length(filing_date) = 9 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dockets involve an asbestos personal injury claim?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE nature_of_suit LIKE '368%'
When did the Department of Energy sign its first contract action of fiscal year 2020?
SELECT min(action_date) AS first_action FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2020'
How many QM9 molecules have no dipole moment at all?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules WHERE dipole_debye = 0
Which hours of 2022 saw the highest statewide electricity load in New York?

SELECT time_stamp, sum(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS statewide_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is New York State's estimated population for 2025?
SELECT try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' AND stname = 'New York'
Which states added the most wind capacity in 2021?
SELECT t_state, sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did real GDP in Los Angeles County change from 2001 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2001 AS double) AS in_2001, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp9 WHERE geofips = '06037' AND linecode = '1'
Which hospitals reported the largest net losses for fiscal 2023?

SELECT a.itm_alphnmrc_itm_txt AS hospital, min(try_cast(n.itm_val_num AS double)) AS net_income FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc AS n JOIN govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_alpha AS a ON a.rpt_rec_num = n.rpt_rec_num AND a.wksht_cd = 'S200001' AND a.line_num = '00300' AND a.clmn_num = '00100' WHERE n.wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND n.line_num = '02900' AND n.clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(n.hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many assistance actions did Veterans Affairs report in February 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_raw_source_assistance_transaction WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'Department of Veterans Affairs' AND action_date LIKE '202402%'
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many quantum physics papers were first posted to arXiv in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE primary_category = 'quant-ph' AND substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) = '2023'
Which molecular formulas have the most conformations in ANI-1x?
SELECT "group", count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.ani1x_conformers WHERE "group" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much federal assistance went to recipients in New York in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2021'
How far apart are studio and four-bedroom fair market rents in Los Angeles County?
SELECT areaname, try_cast(fmr0 AS double) AS studio, try_cast(fmr4 AS double) AS four_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE countyname = 'Los Angeles County' LIMIT 5
How many jobs did Maricopa County, Arizona, have in 2022?
SELECT try_cast(_2022 AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_economy.bea_caemp25n WHERE geofips = '04013' AND linecode = '10'
Which power plants emitted the most carbon dioxide in 2023?
SELECT facility_name, sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) = 2023 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of ChEMBL source papers published change from 2000 to 2020?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_docs WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2000', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which departments listed the most rules in the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?

SELECT element_at(split(acronym, ' | '), 2) AS department, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much has health care employment grown since 2015?
SELECT year, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES6562000001' AND period = 'M12' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY year
Do states or EPA issue more informal enforcement actions over discharge permits?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Medicare clinicians are nurse practitioners?
SELECT cred, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did coal-fired electricity generation change from 2010 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.COW-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2010', '2024') ORDER BY 1
